lines.speaker: An (Sales Executive)
lines.text: Before we dive into the proposal, let me give you a short company overview.

lines.speaker: Phong (Client)

lines.text: Great. I'll use active listening throughout, so please tell me about your challenges.

lines.speaker: An (Sales Executive)
